turn_text: There's a lot of serious things going on. So if you've been doing all this talking with different people, what are some of the biggest concerns that you are hearing from constituents?

Well, when it comes to agriculture, and we talked about this yesterday, and the undersecretary is a great guy. He's actually from Spirit Lake, Iowa. He has some local ties. But getting through this trade agreement with Canada and Mexico, they call it the USMCA, we really need to do that. That's going to help our farmers. That's going to help our manufacturers. And it's going to help consumers. And if we can get that through, it's going to build momentum for other deals with countries like China. And, you know, if we can't get a deal through with Mexico and Canada, our best trading partners, who would expect the president to be able to get something done with China? Well, what is stopping the
process of getting that through? The president has been talking about it for, I don't know, he's President Trump, but it's been talking about it for a long time. Why isn't it there?

Yeah, the deal's pretty much put together. They've been trying to negotiate with Democrats to bring it to the floor. And so far, Speaker Pelosi has said that unless they make changes, she won't bring it to the floor. But I told my administration, friends out there, said, just send it up. Let's let the chips fall where they may. It's a good deal. I was the first elected official in the state of Minnesota to come out for it. I don't believe it's right. I think it's the unwarranted removal of a duly elected president. I voted against the resolution a week or so ago.
